notes_for_developer: This is the Flow A intermediate static-HTML deliverable for mizuho-home. builder stays 'acf' in project-config.json; this file only feeds figma-html-builder's compile step, not the final ACF page.

Header and footer sections below are PLACEHOLDER ONLY (out_of_scope: true) - they exist so the static HTML has visual context matching the Figma frame. The real header/footer are already built as Elementor Theme Builder templates (project-config global_settings) and are NOT re-converted here.

CORRECTION (2026-09-25, post-developer-review): my original claim here that figma/data.json was 0 bytes was WRONG - it was a stale/incomplete read on my part, not a real extractor gap. data.json is populated (430KB) and pages/_figma/file.json (4MB) is the full cached source. All literal copy in content_source has been re-sourced directly from data.json's TEXT node `characters` fields (frames 1:9 desktop groups 1:81/1:31/1:145/1:57/1:10 and 1:400 mobile groups 1:411/1:439/1:445/1:471/1:487/1:518/1:524), not from screenshots. The original screenshot-transcription pass introduced 11 real content drifts (case changes on 'Surgeon-centric' etc., 'Sugita ll' typo silently corrected to 'Sugita II', curly apostrophes/quotes straightened, an ellipsis character substituted for three literal periods) across 22 affected TEXT node instances (desktop+mobile) - all fixed; see each section's own notes for the specific corrections and docs/issues-log.md for the incident writeup. A self-check script re-verified all 85 visible TEXT node strings in those 12 groups now match blueprint.json verbatim (allowing only the pre-approved arrow-icon / &-entity /
-for-\n substitutions): 0 mismatches remain.

Container/gutter, line-height, centering and font-substitution deviations follow the 9 accepted design decisions in docs/02-extraction-review.md verbatim; procedure_band's 3-item pitch (Figma: 481px/378px, uneven) is additionally normalized to an even 3-col grid here as a judgement call consistent with decision #1's container rationale - flagged separately below, not one of the original 9.

No tablet Figma frame exists. Tablet (768px) relies on each recipe's built-in --grid-cols-tablet default (2) / generic collapse; escape-hatch sections (hero_carousel, procedure_band, about_stats) get an authored 768px step by linear interpolation between the 1440 and 430 values, documented inline in each section's extra_css.

notes: Re-sourced from figma/data.json (raw TEXT node characters) after the developer flagged screenshot-transcription drift, 2026-09-25: heading_accent corrected to lowercase 'ours, too.' (node 1:111 - textCase UPPER does the visual capitalising; CSS already applies text-transform:uppercase on .hero-carousel__heading so no visual change) and slide 1's visible label corrected to 'Sugita ll Multi-Purpose Head Frame' (node 1:98/1:419 - two lowercase L's, not the Roman numeral II) per accepted decision #8 (typos entered as designed). The alt text intentionally KEEPS 'Sugita II' (Roman numeral) for screen readers - a deliberate a11y divergence from the visible typo, not an unfixed mismatch.

No recipe fits: this section fuses a page-H1 (Freeman 70/70, 2-line, colour-span second sentence) + a real 2-slide Swiper carousel with dots generated from the actual slide count (Figma shows 3 dots for 2 slides - accepted decision #3, NOT reproduced) + a CTA button pair + a same-row anchor link. media-slider (bare carousel) and hero-two-column/hero-centered (single static media) each cover only part of this; forcing either would drop content. Built as a one-off escape hatch that hand-rolls Swiper (project.slider_library) scoped to its own id per the media-slider id-scoping convention, so it behaves identically to a real media-slider instance without claiming that recipe.
Card border (3px #00B3F0 r48) is visible on the RIGHT card only per Figma (1:95 hidden on the left) - reproduced as-is, not symmetrised.
Stray 1px black stroke on node 1:113 (renders as a black square around the right card's arrow) is a designer leftover - intentionally NOT reproduced, per accepted decision #6.

Mobile order change: cards stack, then 'Browse by Procedure' + dots, THEN the two CTA buttons (full width, stacked) - opposite order to desktop. Encoded in the CSS via flex `order`, not by re-ordering markup, so the DOM keeps CTAs adjacent to the heading for accessibility/SEO while the visual order changes.
768px tablet step (no Figma frame): heading 56px, cards side-by-side at reduced 460px width, CTA row order unchanged from desktop (only mobile flips it) - linear interpolation, not measured.

notes: Re-sourced from figma/data.json 2026-09-25: eyebrow corrected to 'TESTIMONIALS' (node 1:67/1:489 - this word is literally typed in capitals in the raw characters, not just a textCase transform; kept the existing text-transform:uppercase rule anyway since it's harmless/redundant on already-capitalised text). (that's what's actually typed). The desktop node has an internal '\n' between 'to be...' and 'forward-thinking,' that the mobile node (1:519) does NOT have (continuous single line there) - kept as one continuous string rather than forcing a hard break, since the centred 998px-max-width block wraps naturally near the same point and the mobile source confirms no break is required.

Assumes testimonial-grid's per-card slot accepts a photo+name+role+optional-link shape; role lines and the 'Watch now' link are mapped onto that slot rather than a plain 'quote' field, since these are video testimonials, not text quotes. If the compiled recipe's card template only supports a single quote string (no secondary link/button), this card's cta_label/video_url need a small template patch at compile time - flagged as an open question for figma-html-builder.

Assumes testimonial-grid supports an optional 'featured quote' block above/below the card grid (eyebrow+intro heading pattern here, or a centred pull-quote+attribution+CTA below) - if the recipe has no such slot, the featured_quote content needs to move to its own escape-hatch sub-block appended after this section.

Mobile adds a second, full-width 'Watch what clinical experts say about us' CTA after the 3 cards (desktop only shows it once, in intro_statement) - mapped as an extra literal button after `cards` in the mobile CSS/markup, not duplicated in content_source (same URL as intro_statement's cta).
Testimonial thumbnails have burned-in name/title lower-thirds baked into the JPEG pixels (not live text) - used as supplied, safe to export per the extractor's note.
'Watch now' in Figma is a text run positioned over a separate rectangle, not a component - rebuilt here as a real <a> per accepted decision #7.

content_source.heading: ABOUT MIZUHO AMERICA
content_source.body: Established in Boston, Massachusetts in 1993, Mizuho America is part of Mizuho Corporation, a global medical products company with more than a century of commitment to providing surgeons with meticulously crafted equipment for their OR needs. With deep expertise in neurosurgical products, Mizuho America has built a legacy of quality, reliability, and trusted partnership with healthcare professionals. From problem-solving instrument sets developed with clinical experts, to ongoing support of neurosurgeons every day, Mizuho America remains committed to solutions that can help facilitate greater control, precision, and efficiency during the procedure with the goal of better outcomes after.

notes: Re-sourced from figma/data.json 2026-09-25: heading corrected to literal 'ABOUT MIZUHO AMERICA' (node 1:28 on desktop has textCase:null - i.e. it's hard-typed in capitals, not a CSS transform, exactly matching spec.md's own note 'Typed in capitals (no textCase)'; the mobile node 1:526 redundantly also sets textCase:UPPER on the same already-capitalised text). Added text-transform:uppercase to .about-stats__heading anyway for robustness/parity with the mobile style intent - harmless since the stored text is already capitals.

No recipe fits: this is a unique 'stat counter' shape (not in the hero/nav/card-grid/testimonial/faq/gallery-carousel/cta/footer list) - each 'stat' is a composite of a white shadow-offset panel drawn UNDER a colour-alternating card (box-shadow: 21px 0 21px -23px #000, panel drawn on top of the card's left 15px), not a plain title+icon+body card. Forcing card-grid-3col here would mean rebuilding this composite via extra_css anyway, so it's escape-hatched directly and honestly rather than pretending to reuse a recipe.
Accepted decision #4: stat row centred (Figma has it 76px left / 204px right, off-centre) - implemented with a centred flex row + margin:auto, not the Figma absolute x positions.
Accepted decision #2: stat-number line-height corrected from Figma's 36px (font-size 64px, i.e. ratio 0.5625) to ~1.1 (70.4px) here.

Copy check: this page's third stat reads '1000+' (no thousands separator) vs the second stat's '1,800+' (comma) - the inconsistency spec.md flags is reproduced verbatim per accepted decision #8 (typos/inconsistencies entered as designed, flagged to the lead separately).
